summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of Leather Wallet Pakistan e-commerce platform. Verified Swagger docs, slug-based product URLs, auth, cart, order creation, mock JazzCash/EasyPaisa/COD payment flows, and admin dashboard. All 19 backend pytest cases passed. All targeted frontend flows (home -> category slug URL -> product slug detail -> login/register -> add to cart -> checkout with all 4 payment methods -> mock gateway with OTP 1234 -> success page -> admin dashboard) passed end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: On admin session the header shows the word 'Admin' twice (admin nav link label + user name 'Admin' both render). Cosmetic but confusing. Consider using a different label for the user name badge or hiding the 'Admin' link when the user is already the admin.

action_items: No functional action items. Optional: deduplicate the 'Admin' label in the header so admin user's display name does not collide with the Admin nav link.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 915 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, products, cart, orders, payments, seed) for maintainability.

POST /api/orders returns {order_id, total_amount} while GET /api/orders/{id} returns full order with field 'id'. Response shape inconsistency may confuse API consumers — consider returning the full Order object from create_order.

Mock payment validation only checks length of mobile (>=10) and CNIC (==4); consider explicit regex for 11-digit 03XXXXXXXXX and 4-digit numeric CNIC on the backend (frontend enforces regex but backend should too).
PUT /api/orders/{id}/status takes status as a query param; using a Pydantic body or path param + enum would be safer and give proper 400 on invalid values.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@leatherwallet.pk / admin123; Mock wallet OTP: 1234. Ad-hoc test customers created during run (TEST_cust_* and random emails); safe to leave in DB.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed once (already seeded). No new seed data beyond ephemeral test users/orders.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers docs, products (slug), auth (admin + customer), cart CRUD, order creation with all 4 payment methods, mock payments (JazzCash/EasyPaisa success, COD pending, invalid method 400, missing mobile 400), admin status update, admin product CRUD + auto-slug. Frontend Playwright flow validated: home -> /products/category/:cat -> /products/:slug -> auth -> /cart -> /checkout -> /payment/mock?method=jazzcash|easypaisa with OTP 1234 -> /payment/success; COD short-circuits to /orders; admin dashboard loads products and orders tabs. Stripe flow was NOT exercised per request (out of scope).
